CORRECTION, day 159, player-caught: hp.py showed Tristle at 6/8, but that '6' was a tool bug, not a real lingering wound. tools/hp.py's current() caps every historical delta at the CHARACTER'S CURRENT hp_max (now 8, post level-up) rather than the hp_max actually in effect when each event happened (3, for this entire history before today). That let the day-140 CLW heals (+5, +3, +7 against only -2/-3/-7 damage) bank phantom overheal that was never possible at 1st level, where any heal past 3 should have been capped and lost. Recomputed by hand with the correct historical cap (3) throughout: every heal/damage pair in his log nets back to exactly 3/3 (full) before today -- the last event (the troglodyte-ambush retraction, -7 then +7) fully reversed itself, so there was no real unhealed damage carried into this week at all. Today's level-up adds the rolled hit die (5, 3->8) directly to current HP per standard practice, same as max. Anchored to 8/8 outright rather than letting the undercounting-bug math stand. STANDING PRACTICE FOR FUTURE LEVEL-UPS: anchor hp explicitly at the moment of leveling (old current, correctly capped, + the new HD roll) rather than trusting hp.py's retroactive math across a hp_max change -- this bug will recur for anyone else who levels (Ista next, most likely) unless this is done every time.
